doctrines.note: Veterancy: Middle for +1 target, then rest top. Hero pairing: Any. Playstyle kit: X-move in and brace, stay braced and X-move again or use Advance and re-brace every time brace cooldown is up; CCi (Stand Fast) is the reset button — pop it vs polearm ulting you, enemy Imperial Pike, or cavalry charge; never V with Stalwart, only brace; loop is X-move in or advance, brace, repeat. "CCi is mandatory in every build (resets block AND breaks CC). A LOT of viable doctrine combos exist; personal pick is 1x Unit Damage V + full block stack." Formation tip: use F3 formation to move, then transition to F2 and insta-brace — this stacks the Stalwart for much higher damage; bracing with F2 only, the back-row Stalwart is otherwise wasted, and this tech fixes that. Guide edit timestamp (2026-06-27) POST-dates the 2026-06-25 Chaos patch anchor, so doctrine guidance reflects the current season; the shortlist's own assessment of the patch's hitbox-only nerf (Brace damage hitbox −12%, stab damage hitbox −18%) is "no skill/mechanic change — existing doctrine likely still holds, just slightly weaker" (docs/vet-docs/changed-units-shortlist.md), so this build is not flagged stale.

entries.text: Heavy block-break units such as Claymore & Reapers if they have Linebreaker.
Everything with a good CCi doctrine timing.

steps.text: X-move in and brace; stay braced and X-move again, or use Advance and re-brace, every time the brace cooldown is up. Loop: X-move in or advance, brace, repeat.
CCi (Stand Fast) is the reset button: pop it versus a polearm ulting you, an enemy Imperial Pike, or a cavalry charge — it resets both your block bar and any CC on you.

Use the F3 formation to move, then transition to F2 and insta-brace — this stacks the Stalwart and gives much higher damage. Bracing with F2 only otherwise wastes the back-row Stalwart; this tech fixes that.
Never use V with Stalwart — only brace.
